Hi Marissa / Kim,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. Attaching our completed vendor onboarding form and a W9. A couple of questions as we get set up in your PO system:

- Our standard billing cadence is Net60 with monthly invoice submission. Is Redwood able to map supplier invoices into a Net60 payment lane, or do we need to request Net45 to match your internal close windows?
- We sometimes enroll in early-pay programs (we can offer a 1% discount for Net15). Would that be something Redwood can support for a new partner?

We'd like to get a PO number assigned and ship initial consumable units by the week of Sep 18 if that timeline works.

Hi Anna — thanks for the form and the W9, received. Quick next steps from our side: 

1) Please upload the same files to our vendor portal (link below) so procurement can validate tax docs and banking information.
2) Procurement will create a standard PO profile. Our default vendor lane is Net45 to align with monthly close, but we can create a Net60 lane if Finance approves and if billing cadence is truly monthly (please confirm expected invoice frequency).
3) If you want to enroll in an early-pay discount, Finance needs a simple proposal (discount %, duration) — we typically run a 90-day pilot.

Operational notes: PO issuance takes 3 business days after portal validation. To hit Sep 18 ship date, aim to complete portal upload and bank-verification by Sep 6.

For convenience: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/registration/PROCURECO

Would you confirm invoice cadence (monthly / biweekly)? If monthly, we'll route for a Net60 exception request to Finance; otherwise we'll plan for Net45.

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ProcureCo - Net60 exception request + early pay pilot ask

Team — FYI / asking for quick sign-off. ProcureCo is a low-risk supplier (standard services, completed W9). They want a Net60 lane because they invoice monthly on the 1st. We usually onboard to Net45 to match month-end close, but NCC finance can approve Net60 if the vendor cadence is hard monthly. 

They also offered a 1% discount for Net15 (early-pay). My recommendation:
- Approve Net45 as the default PO lane to keep close alignment.
- Offer a 90-day early-pay pilot at 1% for Net15 (finance-funded), measured for invoice accuracy and fraud checks.
- If ProcureCo demonstrates consistent monthly invoicing and reconciles cleanly, re-evaluate Net60 as a permanent lane.

Ben — can you confirm if a 1% early-pay funding commitment for 90 days is acceptable operationally? Kim / Karthik — any objections on PO mapping or portal validation timeline?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ProcureCo - Net60 exception request + early pay pilot ask

Marissa — approved. Finance will support a 90-day early-pay pilot at 1% for Net15 up to $50k/month of eligible invoices. Please include the pilot cap and reporting cadence in the contract addendum.

Operationally: procurement should provision a Net45 PO lane today to avoid close conflicts. If monthly cadence and invoice quality are clean after the pilot, Finance will review a Net60 lane request.
